# voice-loop

> Make AI write in your voice without fine-tuning a model. A local-first
> Python toolkit: build a style fingerprint from writing you already have,
> gate every AI draft with deterministic checks, and teach the system through
> an append-only corrections log you write when you reject a draft.

voice-loop is a free, open-source (MIT) alternative to fine-tuning an LLM on
your own writing. It works alongside Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any local
model and requires no GPU, no cloud account, and no vector database.

## Key facts

- Language: Python, standard library only at its core
- Install: pip install -e . after cloning https://github.com/assafkip/voice-loop
- Input: your existing writing (posts, emails, articles), tagged by channel
- Output: a measured style fingerprint plus deterministic gates that score
  every AI draft against how you statistically write
- Learning loop: rejected drafts become corrections that apply to the next
  prompt immediately; no retraining
- Privacy: the deterministic core (fingerprint, gates, corrections) is local
  files and standard library only, with no telemetry. The optional critic,
  revision and authorship parts call a model backend you name, so text you
  send those goes wherever that model runs

## Main concepts

- Corrections log: append-only record of the corrections you log against an AI
  draft and why, folded into the next prompt
- Style fingerprint: sentence-length distribution, contraction rate, hedge
  count and paragraph rhythm computed as percentiles from your own corpus
- Echo gate: refuses verbatim reuse of the examples inside the prompt
- Biography check: factual claims about the author's career verified against
  a facts file, separate from tone

## Docs

- Install and quickstart: README.md
- Corpus format: corpus/README.md
- Optional authorship metric: authorship/
